metadata.title: Research Community & Collaboration
metadata.description: MSEI Lab workshops, research exchanges, demonstrations and open resources.

intro: MSEI Lab contributes to the research community through collaborative workshops, international exchanges, research demonstrations and open resources. This page records activities connected to the research group. Individual editorial, peer-review, grant-review, examining and academic appointments are documented separately on Dandan Zhang’s personal website.

personalService.title: Academic Service — Dandan Zhang
personalService.description: See Dandan Zhang’s personal conference appointments, editorial activities, reviewing, examinations, institutional roles and public engagement.

featuredFigures.title: Safe World Models for Trustworthy Embodied AI
featuredFigures.description: Contributed to a cross-disciplinary forum on uncertainty, reliability and the deployment of predictive embodied systems, including invited research talks and a panel-and-podcast discussion.

featuredFigures.title: Physical World Models for Scaling Embodied AI
featuredFigures.description: Helped bring together academic and industry speakers for discussions, paper presentations and the WorldArena 2.0 benchmark challenge on real-world physical AI.

featuredFigures.title: Cooperative Intelligence for Embodied Intelligent Systems
featuredFigures.description: Co-organised a workshop connecting multi-agent embodied systems, robotics, autonomous driving and foundation-model research, as also announced by Imperial I-X.
